explanation: I searched Mathlib for lemmas relating ringKrullDim or krullDim to integral ring maps or integral extensions. Under RingTheory/KrullDimension, the only comparison lemmas I found are ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective, ringKrullDim_quotient_le and ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv. None of these involve integrality. The going-up file Ideal/GoingUp.lean has no krullDim statement. It does contain Ideal.comap_lt_comap_of_integral_mem_sdiff, which this proof already uses, but it is a statement about ideals and not a dimension inequality. I found no Mathlib declaration giving ringKrullDim S ≤ ringKrullDim R for an integral ring hom.
